Thanks for the update—adding to stan-users mailing list. There’s a known issue with bad numerical gradients and log probabilities, which can lead to nonsensical results. Have you tried the experiment on the https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/pull/1545 branch? (run `git checkout feature/issue-1544-include-gradient-and-elbo-exceptions`)
